{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"New York State Route 252A (NY 252A) was an east–west state highway located within the town of Chili in Monroe County, New York, in the United States.","title":"New York State Route 252A"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" The western terminus of the route was at an intersection with NY 33A and NY 386 in the hamlet of Chili Center.","title":"New York State Route 252A"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" Its eastern terminus was at a junction with NY 383 near the Greater Rochester International Airport.","title":"New York State Route 252A"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" NY 252A was known as Paul Road and was a 4.40 mi alternate route of NY 252 through Chili; however, it did not directly connect to NY 252.","title":"New York State Route 252A"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Duluth International Airport (IATA: DLH, ICAO: KDLH, FAA LID: DLH) is a city-owned, public-use joint civil-military airport located five nautical miles (9 km) northwest of the central business district of Duluth, a city in Saint Louis County, Minnesota, United States.","title":"Duluth International Airport"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" It serves the Twin Ports area, including Superior, Wisconsin.","title":"Duluth International Airport"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" Mostly used for general aviation but also served by three airlines, it is Minnesota's third-busiest airport, behind Minneapolis–St. Paul International Airport (MSP) and Rochester International Airport; and the state's second-busiest commercial passenger airport, after MSP.","title":"Duluth International Airport"}],"peer_messages":["Unverified peer answer: noanswer"],"previous_answer":"noanswer","question":"Which of the following is home to the 642nd Aviation Support Battalion: Greater Rochester International Airport or Valley International Airport?"}
